request: Calculate the proportion of inspected books with damaged covers and bound the conclusion.
sources: In a fictional library inspection, 20 of the 50 inspected books have damaged covers. The observed damaged-cover proportion is 20/50.
The inspector selected books from one returns trolley, not randomly from the collection.
No information about uninspected books was recorded.

expected.diagnostic: Using 50/20 reverses the part and whole.
